answer_1.quote: The development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) (e.g., , LLaVA , Qwen-VL (Bai et al.,   * The first three authors contribute to this work equally. † Zhihong and Benyou are the corresponding authors. 2023a), Cluade-3-Opus , and GPT-4V (OpenAI, 2023)) represents a leap towards more sophisticated, context-aware AI systems.
answer_1.outputs: The paper addresses NLG tasks in multimodal settings, where models generate natural language responses based on visual inputs, such as describing images, answering questions about them, creating stories, or generating code.

answer_2.quote: we adopt the superb GPT-4-Turbo as the judge to vote for which answer is better given an image, a question, and a pair of answers.

answer_3.quote: we propose to use potent MLLM as the judge with per-sample criteria to evaluate MLLMs.

answer_4.quote: We recruited four undergraduate volunteers , all of whom are students at a university with an all-English curriculum.
answer_4.guideline: Each item in the evaluation set comprises a question associated with an image and two answers generated by models: one from the model under evaluation and the other from the anchor model LLaVA-v1.5-13B.
